description: An unnamed `if` nested inside a nested `dynamic` merges its branch's effects directly into the parent's own namespace (transparent control); the branch's own *second* step reads the branch's *first* step's tool output through `{from: prime.outer.inner.step.value}`, which must see the write live -- the within-branch scope overlay is rebuilt from the enclosing context after every step, never resolved once up front or carried forward as a frozen snapshot (electricity/DESIGN.md §6.3; the P0 finding on PR #440 this rule guards against).
